title: Orca Vault Door
description: A large circular metallic vault door with intricate golden gears stands open in a grassy field. A stylized orca covered in green and blue mosaic patterns stands beside it, one flipper touching the door, while several empty square frames lie scattered in the foreground grass.
prompt: Surreal scene of a massive circular bank vault door with complex golden mechanical gears standing open in a misty green hillside landscape. A stylized orca whale covered in vibrant green and blue mosaic patterns stands on its tail beside the door, touching it with a flipper. Several empty ornate square frames lie scattered in the tall foreground grass. Rolling hills, dark trees, and soft fog in the background, painted in a contemporary illustrative style with clean lines.
